ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Introductory Pedagogy Practicum Prerequisite: High scores in CS 125 and a strong desire to help others with Introduction to Computer Science Investigate approaches to learning and teaching introductory computer science topics through research, discussion and course development. Implement and test new ideas in a classroom format, via online videos, lab section and one-on-one instruction and web-delivered media and apps for introductory computer science students.
